items.title: Scientific and technological trajectories in electrolyzed hydrogen: The emergence of a green–green hybridization process
items.original_context: Abstract Sustainable energy trajectories evolve through processes of knowledge accumulation and recombination within the same trajectory and hybridization between several of them. This paper investigates the emergence of a green hydrogen trajectory by applying a structural main path analysis to both scientific publications and patents related to electrolyzed hydrogen production. Beyond identifying trajectories, we analyze distinct time phases to capture the evolving architecture of the knowledge network.
